voice:
Let your eyes close, and bring your attention to your forehead. Let it smooth out soft and blank. Sissy Drops.
Your jaw relaxes. Your neck goes loose and limp. Sissy Drops.
Feel that warmth pour down through your shoulders your arms heavy and still. As Sissy Drops.
Your chest softens with every breath. Your tummy melts. Sissy Drops. Your legs turn to liquid all the way down to your toes.
Your whole body is loose, limp, and lazy — and the deeper your body relaxes, the deeper your mind follows. Sissy Drops.
Sinking now Sissy Drops into soft, deep trance.
